Customer Success

Never lose context on your accounts again

The Problem

You're managing 50+ accounts. Each one has activity scattered across CRM, support tickets, Slack conversations, product usage logs, and billing systems. By the time you manually piece together what's happening, it's too late—the renewal is at risk or the upsell opportunity is gone.

Fragmented Signals
  • Usage drops aren't connected to support escalations
  • Slack mentions of expansion get buried in noise
  • QBR prep takes hours of manual research
  • No early warning system for churn risk

The Outcome

With IntegrateWise, your Twin watches every account 24/7. It correlates usage patterns, support sentiment, contract timelines, and relationship health—then surfaces what needs your attention before it becomes urgent.

Connected Intelligence
  • Proactive alerts when usage + sentiment diverge
  • Expansion signals automatically flagged with evidence
  • QBR briefs auto-generated from all touchpoints
  • Churn risk scored and explained with data

RevOps

Real-time revenue intelligence at your fingertips

The Problem

Your revenue data lives in silos: pipeline in CRM, actuals in billing, forecasts in spreadsheets, and product adoption in analytics tools. Leadership asks for a revenue health report, and you spend 6 hours manually stitching together the story.

Manual Reconciliation Hell
  • Pipeline data doesn't match billing actuals
  • Forecasts built on stale or incomplete data
  • No visibility into expansion vs new revenue mix
  • Reporting cycles take days instead of minutes

The Outcome

IntegrateWise unifies CRM, billing, product analytics, and finance systems into one intelligent revenue view. Your Twin tracks pipeline velocity, monitors churn signals, and forecasts with precision—all backed by real-time data.

Unified Revenue Intelligence
  • Real-time revenue dashboards auto-updated
  • Pipeline health scored with predictive accuracy
  • Expansion vs new revenue tracked automatically
  • Board-ready reports generated in seconds

Support Ops

Predict escalations before they happen

The Problem

Support tickets are reactive snapshots. By the time a customer opens a critical ticket, the underlying issue has been brewing for weeks. You have no way to connect ticket trends with product usage, customer health, or relationship history.

Reactive Support Model
  • Tickets treated in isolation, no account context
  • No correlation between usage drops and support spikes
  • Escalations happen after relationship damage is done
  • No early warning system for product friction

The Outcome

Your Twin connects support tickets with product analytics, CRM health scores, and customer sentiment. It flags patterns like "usage dropped 40% before this ticket was filed" or "this account has opened 3 tickets in 2 weeks"—giving you context to act proactively.

Proactive Support Intelligence
  • Tickets enriched with full account context
  • Usage anomalies correlated with support trends
  • Escalation risk predicted before ticket is filed
  • Product friction surfaces identified automatically

Suggested IntegrateWise Setup

Connect Tools

Zendesk, Intercom, Salesforce, Amplitude, Slack

Twin Monitors

Ticket velocity, sentiment, usage correlation, account health

Get Alerts

Escalation warnings, friction patterns, proactive outreach suggestions

Finance Ops

Real-time financial intelligence for operators

The Problem

Your financial data is fragmented: ERP for accounting, spreadsheets for budgets, billing systems for revenue, expense tools for spend. Leadership asks "What's our runway?" and you need 2 days to reconcile everything manually.

Spreadsheet Chaos
  • Burn rate calculations done manually each month
  • Budget vs actuals tracked in disconnected sheets
  • No real-time view of cash position
  • Reporting cycles take days instead of hours

The Outcome

IntegrateWise unifies your financial stack into one intelligent memory layer. Your Twin tracks burn rate, monitors runway, flags budget variances, and generates board-ready financial reports—all in real-time.

Unified Financial Intelligence
  • Real-time burn rate and runway tracking
  • Budget vs actuals auto-reconciled daily
  • Cash position updated automatically
  • Board decks generated in minutes, not days

Project Delivery

Ship on time with full context

The Problem

You're managing multiple client projects. Scope is in Linear, client communications in email and Slack, timelines in Asana, and budgets in spreadsheets. When a client asks "Are we on track?" you need hours to piece together the answer.

Scattered Project Context
  • Scope creep hidden in email threads
  • Blockers not connected to timeline impact
  • Budget vs actual hours tracked manually
  • No early warning for delivery risk

The Outcome

Your Twin unifies project management tools, client communications, and time tracking. It flags scope creep, predicts timeline risks, and surfaces blockers before they derail delivery—all with evidence citations.

Unified Project Intelligence

  • Budget vs actuals tracked in real-time
  • Delivery risk predicted with evidence
